input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty, stipulated sum or early-termination fee is payable by Client anywhere in the Agreement, which meets the preferred position. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "shall pay", late-payment interest and termination charges return nothing payable by Client. The termination and term provisions (§§13-14) require only notice, with service continuing to month-end and no exit payment or minimum-remaining-value obligation. The planner-flagged hooks are clean: §7 (spamming) prohibits the conduct but imposes no per-message or fixed charge on Client, and §5 contains only a monthly minimum service charge ($____ per month for Hosting and Support Services) that is ongoing pricing for services actually received rather than a damages or termination amount — noted, not a deviation under this rule. Nothing here approaches walk-away territory.
